text_block_list.text:
On the way back from an outing with Agnes 
Digital, while walking through the park...

text_block_list.name: Fangirl
text_block_list.text: Um... um, Digital-dono...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ohooo~! You're my fellow comrade from the 
Umamusume fan events! Could it be you're 
here to hold a strategy meeting for the 
next one!?

text_block_list.name: Fangirl
text_block_list.text:
No... to tell the truth, um... I'm 
thinking of "graduating" from the fandom.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Not *that* kind of "passing on"! Wait, why 
do you ask...?

text_block_list.name: Fangirl
text_block_list.text:
I want to go to a top-tier school. ...I'll 
give up my otaku hobbies and focus on 
studying.

text_block_list.name: Fangirl
text_block_list.text:
So... I would like to entrust my 
merchandise to you, Digital-dono!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Fweh, for me...?

text_block_list.name: Fangirl
text_block_list.text:
Um, because I know that you... will truly 
treasure it...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. I will accept the 
merchandise.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
However! Just to be clear, okay? I'm 
strictly "holding onto it for you."
choice_data_list: Just holding onto it for you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Yes, exactly! It's not retirement, just a 
hiatus! Please come back once your studies 
have settled down!

text_block_list.name: Fangirl
text_block_list.text:
B-But... can I really go back? I just 
don't have the confidence...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
You will be able to come back. I believe 
that with all my heart...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...Do you remember the day we stood in 
line for merch, freezing in the middle of 
that cold snap...?

text_block_list.name: Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
The merchandise line is over here! It'll 
be about a one-hour wait until you can 
make your purchase!
(Whooosh, WHOOOOOOSH!!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Uuu... I should've bundled up more... It's 
cold... So cold...

text_block_list.name: Fangirl
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... if you'd like, we can take turns 
sharing this hand warmer!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure...!? To someone like me, who 
failed to do her best on the merch 
line...!

text_block_list.name: Fangirl
text_block_list.text:
Aren't we comrades who support our oshi?! 
Even if cataclysms strike, let's welcome 
that merch home together!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Howaaa~! I am ever so grateful! I will 
most certainly win this battle!

text_block_list.name: Fangirl
text_block_list.text:
"...That's right. Supporting my fav is my 
reason for living... That's who I am..."

text_block_list.name: Fangirl
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, it might take a really long time! 
But I will definitely return! Back to my 
otaku self!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"I'll wait forever! We otaku are a patient 
breed who can sit seiza waiting for new 
updates indefinitely...!"
choice_data_list: Is this also... love for Umamusume?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Sometimes we compete to get 
event tickets, and sometimes we support 
our faves together!

text_block_list.name: Fangirl
text_block_list.text:
And trading duplicate merch... Interacting 
with fellow fans is one of the best parts 
of supporting your favs!

text_block_list.name: Fangirl
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I wanna do it again! Holding back 
is literally unwinnable game of the year!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Then how about doing some fan activities 
as a break from studying?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
“Even if it's just a casual interest, 
supporting your favorites is totally fine. 
What matters most is your love for the 
Umamusume girls, after all.”

text_block_list.name: Fangirl
text_block_list.text:
I-I'll... study hard too, but even if it's 
just a little bit of time, I want to keep 
supporting my fave!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I will keep an eye on you so that it does 
not interfere with your studies... 
......Welcome back.

The two shared a firm handshake... and the 
hiatus on their fan activities came to an 
end at supersonic speed!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Not at all... I merely lent a hand to a 
comrade... The love I dedicate to the 
Umamusume is still nowhere near enough.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Because the sheer "blessedness" I receive 
from the Umamusume is worth far more than 
that...!

text_block_list.name: Fangirl
text_block_list.text:
Digital-dono...! I knew entrusting the 
merch to you was the right choice.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"...J-Just out of curiosity, though. Among 
the merch we're holding, is that 
super-rare lottery-exclusive live 
disc...?"

text_block_list.name: Fangirl
text_block_list.text:
You have great taste! Of course we have 
it~. Ehehe, please enjoy it to your 
heart's content!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Praise be, praise be~~! I promise to watch 
it twice a day, including your share!

I will worship the merch for my comrades' 
sake too— such was the hardened resolve of 
Agnes Digital.
